name: Nox Ground Unit
title: Nox Ground Unit
note: Box W frame (X across, Y along the axle toward the front, Z up; the swap arm hub at the origin, the drone seat at (0, 167.1, 155.3), nox/box/catch_system.py SEAT_TO_W). In: the swap arm v7 at park with 7 bay receivers (the two nearest the top dropped, Spark 3 Nov) and two packs, the stand of the built demo, the v2 enclosure sheets and PSU as boxes, the funnel drawn 3 Nov on the latch footprint, the Scout's receiver and cartridge seated in it. Out: the v1 ring frames, posts, brackets and bay modules (superseded by the v2 layout, whose bodies are not drawn), the hold-down, the electronics. The nox repo's own master page of the box: https://claude.ai/artifact/RX2CexkfhB5UoQHnGTVgCC (27 Oct). Imported by tools/import_box.py from sparkiscool/nox.
